what: First Citizens BancShares is a bank holding company that grew enormously when it acquired Silicon Valley Bank out of receivership in 2023. It combines a traditional southeastern retail bank with technology and life sciences lending.
customers: Households and businesses across its branch network, technology and life sciences companies, and equipment finance customers nationally.
money: retail and commercial banking across the Southeast
lending to technology, life sciences and venture capital firms
moat: The Silicon Valley Bank franchise acquired at a very favourable price, with deposit relationships across the venture-backed technology sector that no other bank has.
risks: Technology and venture lending is a volatile business through cycles
Deposit costs rise when clients move money to higher-yielding accounts
It pays only a small dividend
opportunities: Revenue grew about 23% a year over three years including the acquisition
Net margin of 23% with a strong capital position
Recovering venture capital activity would revive deposit and loan growth
watch: Deposit balances in the SVB business and credit quality in technology lending.
